definition: The Shannon entropy of the ordinal patterns of order consecutive prices in the last window prices, divided by ln(order!) so it runs from 0 to 1.
boundaries: Reads only the order of values, not their size; a tie keeps the earlier value first. It measures how patterned the moves are, not their direction.
recognition: Near 1 for noise, lower when some orderings repeat.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
